files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
A cadet transferred out three days ago but their account is still active. Disable it. Then lock the supply-requisitions file so the supply cadet can no longer approve their own requests.

1. net user transferred-cadet /active:no
2. icacls requisitions.txt /deny supply-cadet:F
files.C:\\Citadel\\requisitions.txt: SUPPLY REQUISITIONS — self-approval gap: supply-cadet can currently both request and approve here.

steps.title: Split request from approval
steps.body: Astro: "One person, both roles — that's the gap. Lock it." `icacls requisitions.txt /deny supply-cadet:F`.
